# Civil Works Coordination

> MENASCO's civil capability is delivered in close coordination with a trusted civil engineering partner, aligning structural and site works with our own MEP scope from design through handover. This integrated approach keeps civil and building-services interfaces coordinated from the outset, reducing rework and supporting a single, consistent project programme.
